subject: Mathematics

source.subtopic: Investigate which objects roll or slide (spheres, prisms); straight and curved sides

show.line: A ball is a sphere. It is round all over, so it rolls. A box has flat sides. It slides.

rounds.prompt: Which object will roll down the ramp?
rounds.praise: Yes! The ball is round, so it rolls.

rounds.prompt: Which object slides but does not roll?
rounds.praise: Yes! The brick has flat sides. It slides.

rounds.prompt: Look at this tin. Can it roll? Say yes or no.
Which object has curved sides and flat sides? It rolls and it slides.
rounds.praise: Yes! A tin has a curved side and two flat ends.

rounds.prompt: Does it roll, or does it slide? Put each object in its group.
Count the flat sides on this box. How many?

hints: Round things roll. Flat sides slide.
Think about pushing it down a slide. Does it tumble or glide?

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will say which one rolls.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: The box rolls down the ramp!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! The box slides. The ball rolls.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's push them together. The ball rolls away. The box slides!

parent_line: Can say which objects roll or slide, and why.
